comment: ORCHID literature values, Version 1, machine-extracted. Evidence class: experimental. ORCHID observation ids (orchid-literature `id`, one per value, in value order): ORC-57NY3YXVJ7.5ff086
orchid_standard_temperature: 298 K read as the standard reference temperature 298.15 K

orchid_uncertainty.weight_rule: no printed uncertainty: weight left at 1 (ESPEI default)

orchid_weight_floor.rule: optional minimum-sigma policy (E6): sigma_eff = max(sigma, sigma_floor) with sigma_floor = ESPEI's experimental default for the property (500 J/mol for enthalpies and for the chemical potential of activities, 0.2 J/mol/K for entropies and heat capacities); suggested_weight = min(weight, 1). The printed sigma is unchanged (orchid_uncertainty); use suggested_weight when printed sigmas are much smaller than the scatter between sources (e.g. formation enthalpies printed with +-80 J/mol-atom while other measurements differ by 1-2 kJ/mol-atom)

endmember.reference: SER phases of the TDB's ELEMENT lines (ESPEI _FORM convention); the value's printed reference state names the same phases (or none)
